tolerance.note: values, peaks, bass, ceilDb; band edges use relative 1e-5

replay: Build a fresh pipeline from scenario.config (decode it with VisualizerConfig's lenient decoder; initial state: ceilDb -12, rawDb -160, values/peaks/bass 0). Frames are 0-based: for f = 0 ..< frames, write raw(f) into rawDb, then call process(dt: dt(f)). The snapshot with frame = f is the state after that call (values, peaks, bass, ceilDb = pipeline.ceilingDb). Snapshots are recorded when (f+1) % recordEvery == 0 or f == frames-1. raw(f) and dt(f) are given in each scenario's description; time t for bandsSimulated is in seconds.

scenarios.name: simulated_defaults
scenarios.description: Default config, 180 frames at dt=1/60. raw(frame f) = bandsSimulated(t = (f+1)/60) with noise term 0.

scenarios.name: step_gate_release
scenarios.description: Default config. Frames 0-9 raw=-160 (below gate), 10-69 raw=-20 flat, 70-159 raw=-160. dt=1/60. Exercises gate, AGC attack/release, attack/release smoothing, peak hold and gravity.

scenarios.name: fixed_ceiling_no_smoothing
scenarios.description: agc=false, ceilingDb=-12, 32 bands 40 Hz-12 kHz, tilt 0, spatial 0, gamma 1. raw_i(f) = -30 + 20*sin(0.37*i + 0.21*f). dt(f) = 1/60 if f is even, 1/120 if f is odd (frame 0 uses 1/60).

scenarios.name: zero_dt_frames
scenarios.description: Default config. raw = bandsSimulated(t=0.5) every frame (noise 0). dt=1/60 except every 4th frame (f%4==3) where dt=0: values/peaks/bass must not move on dt=0 frames; AGC may not move either.
